description: Data layer: models, services, and providers for authentication, expenses, and categories. Creates user_model.dart, expense_model.dart (with fields: id, userId, amount, currencyCode, category, note, date, receiptImageUrl, createdAt, updatedAt, toJson/fromJson), category_model.dart (id, name, icon, color, isDefault, userId, toJson/fromJson). Implements auth_service.dart with Firebase Auth (signInWithGoogle, signInWithEmail, signUpWithEmail, signOut, getCurrentUser, resetPassword), database_service.dart with Firestore CRUD (addExpense, updateExpense, deleteExpense, getExpenses with filters, addCategory, updateCategory, deleteCategory, getCategories), storage_service.dart for receipt uploads, currency_service.dart for currency list and selection, local_storage_service.dart with Hive for offline caching. Creates providers: auth_provider.dart (user state, auth methods), expense_provider.dart (expense list, CRUD, filtering, sorting), category_provider.dart (category list, CRUD).
steps: Create lib/models/user_model.dart: User class with id, email, displayName, photoUrl, selectedCurrency, createdAt, toJson/fromJson methods

Create lib/models/category_model.dart: Category class with id, name, iconCodePoint, colorValue, isDefault, userId, toJson/fromJson, default categories list (Food, Transport, Shopping, Bills, Health, Entertainment, Travel, Education, Other)
Create lib/models/expense_model.dart: Expense class with id, userId, amount, currencyCode, categoryId, note, date, receiptImageUrl, createdAt, updatedAt, toJson/fromJson

Create lib/services/auth_service.dart: implement signInWithGoogle using google_sign_in + firebase_auth, signInWithEmailAndPassword, createUserWithEmailAndPassword, signOut, authStateChanges stream, getCurrentUser, sendPasswordResetEmail, updateUserProfile

Create lib/services/database_service.dart: Firestore methods - addExpense, updateExpense, deleteExpense, getExpenseById, getExpensesStream(userId, dateRange, categoryFilter), addCategory, updateCategory, deleteCategory, getCategoriesStream(userId), getUserProfile, updateUserProfile
Create lib/services/storage_service.dart: uploadReceiptImage(File image, String expenseId) returns download URL, deleteReceiptImage(String url)
Create lib/services/currency_service.dart: getAllCurrencies() returns list from app_constants, getDefaultCurrency() returns UGX, saveCurrencyPreference(code) to Firestore user doc
Create lib/services/local_storage_service.dart: init Hive, registerAdapters for models, cacheExpenses, getCachedExpenses, cacheCategories, getCachedCategories, clear cache methods

Create lib/providers/auth_provider.dart: ChangeNotifier with User? currentUser, AuthStatus enum (uninitialized, authenticated, unauthenticated), signInWithGoogle/Email methods calling auth_service, signOut, listen to authStateChanges
Create lib/providers/category_provider.dart: ChangeNotifier with List<Category> categories, loading state, loadCategories, addCategory, updateCategory, deleteCategory, getDefaultCategories

Create lib/providers/expense_provider.dart: ChangeNotifier with List<Expense> expenses, loading state, DateRange? selectedDateRange, Category? selectedCategoryFilter, loadExpenses, addExpense, updateExpense, deleteExpense, applyFilters, getTotalByCategory, getTotalByCurrency, sortByDate/Amount
acceptance_criteria: All model classes have complete toJson/fromJson with no fields missing
auth_service connects to Firebase Auth and can sign in test user
Providers properly notify listeners on state changes
Unit tests for models toJson/fromJson pass
Unit tests for utility methods in providers pass
verification: Run 'flutter analyze' and confirm zero issues
Run 'flutter test' for model serialization tests
Create Firebase project manually at console.firebase.google.com
Run 'flutterfire configure' to add Firebase config files
Run 'flutter run' and verify Firebase initialization succeeds in logs
